cues.en: G'day Chris here, welcome to Clickspring. In this first video of what will be a
cues.zh: 大家好，我是 Chris，欢迎来到 Clickspring。这是本系列的第一个视频，接下来会是

cues.en: multi-part series, I begin the construction of a John Wilding Large Wheel skeleton clock,
cues.zh: 一个多集系列，我将开始制作 John Wilding 大轮骨架钟，

cues.en: by making the frames.
cues.zh: 先从框架做起。

cues.en: I'm going to model most of the parts in CAD
cues.zh: 我打算用 CAD 给大部分零件建模

cues.en: as I go along; it should make it easier to follow what I'm doing in each video.
cues.zh: 边做边建；这样每个视频里，大家会更容易看懂我在做什么。

cues.en: But in this case, it also has the added benefit that I can use a printout of the model
cues.zh: 但这次还有个额外好处：我可以把模型的打印图

cues.en: as a template to cut out the basic shape of the frame.
cues.zh: 当作模板，切出框架的基本形状。

cues.en: The brass is 3/16 inch engravers brass. And the glue I'm using is an oil based spray.
cues.zh: 黄铜是3/16英寸的雕刻黄铜。我用的胶是油性喷胶。

cues.en: it holds up quite well to all the handling this part gets while its being made.
cues.zh: 零件制作过程中要经受各种操作，它都相当耐用。

cues.en: I want the frames to be an exact match, so I'm cutting out both of them at the same time, using the one template
cues.zh: 我希望这些框架完全一致，所以用同一个模板同时切出两个。

cues.en: And for the time being I'm using these machinist clamps to hold them together.
cues.zh: 目前我用这些机加工夹钳把它们夹在一起。

cues.en: But ideally I want to do away with these clamps, and hold the plates together
cues.zh: 但理想情况下，我想不用这些夹钳，把板固定在一起

cues.en: using cap screws at each of the pillar hole locations. You'll see what I mean later.
cues.zh: 在每个支柱孔的位置用内六角螺钉。后面你就明白我的意思了。

cues.en: Before I can deal with that though, I need a way of registering the plates together
cues.zh: 不过在解决那个问题之前，我得先把这两块板对齐定位

cues.en: so that whenever they are pulled apart they will go back together in exactly the same way.
cues.zh: 这样每当它们被拆开，再装回去时都能完全回到原来的位置。

cues.en: I'm going to do that with some tapered brass clock pins.
cues.zh: 我打算用几根锥形黄铜钟表销钉来做这件事。

cues.en: I've decided to put one in the middle of the frame, and the other on the left leg.
cues.zh: 我决定把一根装在框架中间，另一根装在左腿上。

cues.en: That should be far enough apart to give a good solid register,
cues.zh: 两者的间距应该足够远，能提供稳固可靠的对齐定位，

cues.en: and resist any twist of the plates while I work on them.
cues.zh: 并且在我加工时防止板子发生任何扭动。

cues.en: At the very end of the project, I'll plug these holes. All going well, there should be no trace that they were ever there.
cues.zh: 项目到最后，我会把这些孔堵上。一切顺利的话，应该看不出它们曾经存在过。

cues.en: The pilot holes were then opened up with a tapered broach to accept the pins.
cues.zh: 接着用锥形拉刀扩开导向孔，以便装入销钉。

cues.en: And the hole was widened until the pins could be inserted deep enough to go through both of the plates.
cues.zh: 孔被扩宽，直到销钉能插得足够深，穿过两块板。

cues.en: Once that was the case, then the clamps were removed, the plates separated
cues.zh: 做到这一步后，拆下夹具，分开两块板

cues.en: and a carbide burr used to lightly countersink the holes on the inner surface.
cues.zh: 并用硬质合金旋转锉在内表面对孔轻轻锪沉孔。

cues.en: And then the pins were hammered in.
cues.zh: 然后把销钉敲了进去。

cues.en: Now that the register pins are in place, the plates are reattached, the clamps put back on,
cues.zh: 既然定位销已经就位，板子重新装好，夹具也装回去，

cues.en: and then the 3 pillar holes can be drilled out in preparation for accepting screws.
cues.zh: 然后就可以钻出3个柱孔，为装螺钉做准备。

cues.en: I can now do away with the toolmakers clamps.
cues.zh: 现在我可以把工具夹钳撤掉了。

cues.en: And tap each of the 3 holes in the bottom plate for a 6mm cap screw.
cues.zh: 再把底板上的3个孔分别攻丝，用来装6mm内六角螺钉。

cues.en: The 3 holes in the top plate are then drilled to give clearance for the same size screw.
cues.zh: 然后把顶板上的3个孔钻成通孔，给同样尺寸的螺钉留出间隙。

cues.en: The tapping throws up a burr, and I want the plates to sit perfectly flush,
cues.zh: 攻丝会产生毛刺，而我希望两块板能完全齐平，

cues.en: so I deburred the inner side of the tapped holes, and then the plates were reattached
cues.zh: 所以我把螺纹孔的内侧去了毛刺，然后把两块板重新装上，

cues.en: by locating them on the register pins, and then this time holding them together using the cap screws.
cues.zh: 用定位销把它们定位，这次再用内六角螺钉把它们固定在一起。

cues.en: So now the waste stock can be cut away, and the plates will still stay tightly registered together through the whole process.
cues.zh: 这样现在就可以把余料切掉了，整个过程中两块板仍会紧紧地保持定位在一起。

cues.en: Then I got to work with the scroll saw, cutting away most of the waste stock.
cues.zh: 接着我就用线锯开工，把大部分余料切掉。

cues.en: Off camera, I drilled a little hole in this diamond shaped section, to give entry to the scroll saw blade for that inside cut.
cues.zh: 在镜头外，我在这个菱形部分钻了一个小孔，为线锯刀片进入进行内部切割提供通道。

cues.en: Next up I used this little bench filing machine to clean up the cuts from the scroll saw,
cues.zh: 接下来，我使用这台小型台式锉磨机来清理线锯切割后的边缘，

cues.en: and also to clear out the corners...
cues.zh: 同时也用来清除角落……

cues.en: Then I used a belt sander to bring all of the surfaces closer to the line,
cues.zh: 然后，我用带式砂光机将所有表面磨得更接近线条，

cues.en: although I left it just a little short for final finishing.
cues.zh: 不过，我故意留了一点余量，以便最后精修。

cues.en: Now you could do all of this without the power tools,
cues.zh: 现在，你可以不用电动工具完成所有这些工作，

cues.en: but there's no doubt, they make the job a lot easier, and they save a lot of time.
cues.zh: 但毫无疑问，它们让工作轻松了许多，也节省了大量时间。

cues.en: The circular sections at the pillar holes need to be spot on, so I've turned up this little filing guide from mild steel
cues.zh: 柱孔处的圆弧部分必须分毫不差，所以我用低碳钢车出了这个小锉削导规

cues.en: to limit the cut, and I'm finishing up those areas with a fine cut file on the filing machine.
cues.zh: 来限制锉削量，然后在锉床上用细齿锉刀把这些区域修整好。

cues.en: And then from here it was all hand finishing at the bench vise.
cues.zh: 接下来就是在台虎钳上全部手工修整，

cues.en: using files to get the curves nice and smooth and symmetrical,
cues.zh: 用锉刀把曲线锉得平滑又对称，

cues.en: and to clear out and square up the corners.
cues.zh: 并把各个角清理干净、锉方。

cues.en: That was followed by papering of the edges.
cues.zh: 之后再用砂纸打磨边缘。

cues.en: First with 400 grit,
cues.zh: 先用400目砂纸，

cues.en: and then 800 grit, to leave a nice surface finish.
cues.zh: 然后用800目，留下漂亮的表面光洁度。

cues.en: I'm finished with the paper template, so that can be removed with a little white spirits.
cues.zh: 纸模板已经搞定，可以用一点白酒精把它取下来。

cues.en: I wont be doing any polishing of the frames at this point, I'll do that right at the end when the clock is almost complete.
cues.zh: 现在我不打算抛光框架，等最后钟快完成时再处理。

cues.en: And then briefly, it's back to the mill, to drill out the 3 pillar holes,
cues.zh: 然后简单回到铣床，钻出3个柱孔，

cues.en: and then ream them 1/4 inch to accept the pillars later.
cues.zh: 再铰到1/4英寸，方便后面安装柱子。

cues.en: Now that all of the metal has been cleared away, here's a better view of how the register pins work
cues.zh: 金属都清理掉后，能更清楚地看到定位销是怎么起作用的

cues.en: I'll need to be able to bring the plates back together like this several times down the track, for drilling pivot holes.
cues.zh: 之后我得能像这样把板子重新合拢好几次，用来钻枢轴孔

cues.en: And that's the frames complete. In the next few videos, I'll make the pillars, washers and screws.
cues.zh: 框架部分就完成了。接下来几个视频里，我会做支柱、垫圈和螺丝

cues.en: Thanks for watching, I'll see you later.
cues.zh: 感谢观看，回头见
